note: For each x, prove C_G(x) is a subgroup and explicitly biject G/C_G(x) with the conjugacy class. If x is noncentral, C_G(x) is proper, hence has order p^m with m<n and class size p^{n-m}, a multiple of p. Partition G into central singleton classes and noncentral classes to obtain p^n=|Z(G)|+sum of multiples of p. Then |Z(G)| is a positive multiple of p and therefore at least 2.
